data_digests.what: content digests of the primary grid's inputs; see the module docstring

backtests.hit: 1{r_t < VaR_t}, strict, as evaluate.py records it
backtests.policy: score: a row is excluded only where its hit indicator is NaN

pending.blocked_on: D-004: dates are fixed at grid freeze, not before.
pending.label: Latest 2025-26 stress window

cross_asset.kendall: tau-b, scipy.stats.kendalltau, on the two rankings of the 13 models
cross_asset.rank: 1 = smallest mean loss within the asset, on the listwise-complete sample the MCS used; ties share the minimum rank

dm.hln: factor sqrt((n + 1 - 2h + h(h-1)/n)/n) at h = 1, reference t_{n-1}

econ.sharpe_ci: percentile moving-block bootstrap of Sharpe(model) - Sharpe(baseline), one index sequence for both series, 95 %

mcs.block_length_rule: Politis-White (2004; Patton, Politis & White 2009), largest over the pairwise loss differentials of the listwise-complete sample, rounded up, floored at the horizon
mcs.bootstrap: moving block (Kuensch 1989), non-circular, one index sequence per resample shared by every model
